item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Green Day + Miley Cyrus @ Crypto.com Arena 2022-02-12
item.description:
this was a great one and I am not even a fan. Which is good because there were no $10 tickets tonight. Ended up paying $80 to a traditional street scalper (not always a common sight anymore) for upper deck but was relocated downstairs. He did a phone to phone transfer and I handed over the $80.
